Geometry-derived analysis shows Li centers with six O neighbors in an octahedral arrangement, while Mn centers have eight neighbors (six O and two Li), and O centers have four neighbors (two Li, two Mn). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Li octahedra and between O-centered four-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between Mn polyhedra.
